title: Minimizing in a subspace containing the support implies minimizing (Simon 7.3.1, footnote 2) (fresh-named registered obligation)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with m ≥ 1, V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace and T ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) minimizing in V (IsMinimizingIn T V: T is integer multiplicity and M_W(T) ≤ M_W(S) whenever W ⊂⊂ ℝ^P is open and S is an integer multiplicity current with ∂S = ∂T and spt(S − T) a compact subset of V ∩ W) with spt T ⊆ V. Then T is minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn T univ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < m → IsMinimizingIn T (V : Set (Euclid P)) → T.support ⊆ (V : Set (Euclid P)) → IsMinimizingIn T univ
